recipe.name: Amber Highball
recipe.description: A sour, fruity zero-proof highball of fresh tangerine infused with bruised lemongrass, lengthened with soda.
steps: Bruise the lemongrass stalk with the back of a knife and put it in a highball glass.
Add the tangerine juice (and the sugar syrup, if you like it sweeter) and stir for 30 seconds to draw out the lemongrass.
Fill the glass with ice, top with chilled soda and stir gently.
recipe.garnish: Tangerine wheel and the lemongrass stalk
